How the builder works

1
Measure the spot
Beams: the length of each run, plus the width and depth you want. Corbels and brackets: the depth of the overhang and the height you have. Flat trim: length and width.
2
Enter your size, then style it
Put your dimensions into the builder, then choose the profile and finish options.
3
Double-check, then order
Custom pieces are made to order for you, so they can't be returned. A second look at your numbers is time well spent.

Send us your dimensions

Call 1-888-573-3768 (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT, Sat 8am-12pm CT) or email cs@architecturaldepot.com with your measurements and a photo of the space. We'll help you confirm the size before it's built.
